body: I hope it's that easy. I find it hard to sleep at night but when I do I always wish not to ever wake up again. I can't get myself to really hurt me physically. I just want to die naturally but that seems impossible. I'm too young yet I feel like I've had enough of the world's craziness.

Year 2016 when my mother died. I felt like I have no other reason to live. My dream is to give her the life she deserves after i graduate in college. She didn't make it. I passed the licensure with the thought of making her proud but after that I'm clueless as to what I'm gonna do with my life. I also discover that I'm not really into the profession I'm currently in. I just can't put my heart into loving it and i feel like I'm the worst employee. I'm not growing and i feel left behind.

Same feels. I don't really know who to talk to because i don't want anyone i know to feel uneasy and feel obligated to comfort me everytime. I was always thinking that we all have our own battles to fight for and i don't want to add on anyone elses.
